dct_description_sm: Abstract: This datalayer shows the location of 1,898 public and 623 private schools, pre-school through high school, in Massachusetts. This data was developed by the Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection's (DEP) GIS Program based on database information provided by the Massachusetts Department of Education (DOE).
Purpose: The data set was developed for display and analysis using GIS.

Supplemental information: MassGIS maintains this datalayer. In May 2002 the Penikese School point was moved from its adminstrative office address in Woods Hole to is correct location on Penikese Island.
